title: Unprotected Females in Sicily, Calabria, and on the Top of Mount Ætna
omitted_from_reading: The printed contents are in the JSON only. The publisher’s catalogue bound at the end of the scanned copy is not transcribed.
notes_on_text: The book names no author; it is attributed to Emily Lowe, who also wrote “Unprotected Females in Norway” (1857), mentioned in a footnote.

The four plates are chromolithographs; the scan is not in full colour, so they are shown as the scan has them. The captions of the first two plates are cut at the scan’s edge: the frontispiece’s is read from the tops of its letters, and that of the plate of Agrigentum cannot be read.
